### New

- **Floating camera windows:** A picture-in-picture video call with the camera on no longer caps the whole screen at 60 Hz.
- **Camera cap toggle:** An optional setting removes Android's 60 Hz camera cap for every app, full-screen camera apps included.
- **Settings screen:** Open it from your Xposed manager to switch either option and see whether the module is active.

> [!NOTE]
> **Known issues**
>
> - **Framework support:** The module needs an Xposed framework with libxposed API 101 or newer, such as Vector 2.1 and later.
